title: The Question on the Way Home
title_ja: 帰り道で思い出した質問
fact_notes: 登場人物・場所・出来事は架空の教材例。特定の研究結果・制度・医学的助言を示すものではない。参考リンクは制作台帳であり実証資料ではない。

sentences.en: Emi went to a local clinic with her father on Tuesday.
sentences.ja: 火曜日、エミは父親と地元の診療所に行った。

sentences.en: He had an appointment to discuss the results of a recent examination.
sentences.ja: 父は最近の検査結果について話す予約があった。

sentences.en: Before leaving home, he planned to ask the doctor several questions.
sentences.ja: 家を出る前に医師にいくつか質問するつもりだった。

sentences.en: However, he did not write any of them down.
sentences.ja: しかし一つも書き留めなかった。

sentences.en: During the appointment, the doctor explained the results in simple language.
sentences.ja: 診察中、医師は結果を分かりやすい言葉で説明した。

sentences.en: Emi's father listened carefully and asked about his next visit.
sentences.ja: エミの父は注意深く聞き、次の受診について質問した。

sentences.en: He thought that he had remembered everything he wanted to ask.
sentences.ja: 聞きたいことをすべて思い出せたと思った。

sentences.en: Only on the way home did he remember another important question.
sentences.ja: 帰り道になって初めて、別の大事な質問を思い出した。

sentences.en: Emi suggested preparing a short list before the next appointment.
sentences.ja: エミは次の診察の前に短いリストを用意するよう提案した。

sentences.en: Together, they wrote down his questions and left room for answers.
sentences.ja: 二人で質問を書き、答えを書くスペースを残した。

sentences.en: Her father marked the question that was most important to him.
sentences.ja: 父は自分にとって最も重要な質問に印をつけた。

sentences.en: He also decided to bring a pen to the clinic.
sentences.ja: 診療所にペンを持参することにもした。

sentences.en: At his next visit, he showed the list to the doctor.
sentences.ja: 次の受診で、父は医師にリストを見せた。

sentences.en: The doctor answered the questions and gave him time to take notes.
sentences.ja: 医師は質問に答え、メモを取る時間を与えた。

sentences.en: When an explanation was unclear, he asked the doctor to explain again.
sentences.ja: 説明が分かりにくいとき、父は再説明を求めた。

sentences.en: Emi waited outside because her father wanted to speak privately.
sentences.ja: 父が個人的に話したかったためエミは外で待った。

sentences.en: Later, her father said that the list had made the conversation easier.
sentences.ja: 後で父はリストのおかげで会話が楽になったと言った。

sentences.en: He still had to make decisions together with his doctor.
sentences.ja: 引き続き医師と一緒に決定する必要があった。

sentences.en: The paper could not provide medical advice on its own.
sentences.ja: 紙自体が医学的な助言を与えることはできなかった。

sentences.en: But it helped him take a more active part in the discussion.
sentences.ja: しかし話し合いにより積極的に参加する助けになった。

questions.prompt: Why did Emi's father visit the clinic?
questions.explanation_ja: 検査結果を話し合うため。

questions.prompt: What did he fail to do before the first visit?
questions.explanation_ja: 質問を書き留めなかった。

questions.prompt: When did he remember another question?

questions.explanation_ja: 質問リストを事前に準備すること。

questions.prompt: What did her father mark on the list?
options: The question most important to him.
questions.explanation_ja: 最重要の質問に印をつけた。

questions.prompt: What did he do when an explanation was unclear?
questions.explanation_ja: 医師に再説明を求めた。
ほかの人がいないところでという意味。

questions.prompt: Why did Emi stay outside during the second visit?
options: Her father wanted to speak in private.
The doctor had canceled the appointment.
questions.explanation_ja: 父が個人的に話したかった。

questions.prompt: What could the paper not do on its own?
questions.explanation_ja: 紙自体は医学的助言を提供できない。

questions.prompt: What does the story mainly illustrate?
options: Patients should make medical decisions without doctors.
Preparing questions can support communication at a medical visit.
Family members must attend all appointments.
Doctors should avoid explaining examination results.
questions.explanation_ja: 質問の準備が受診時のコミュニケーションを助ける。

grammar.explanation_ja: before＋動名詞で先行する行動を表す。

grammar.focus: Only on the way home did he remember
grammar.explanation_ja: onlyで始まる副詞句の前置による倒置。
suggestは動名詞を目的語に取れる。

discourse.role_ja: 質問する意図と準備しなかったことを対比。
診察中という時間を示す。
エミが外で待った理由を示す。
紙自体の限界と会話への役立ちを対比。

paraphrases.source: He thought that he had remembered everything he wanted to ask.
paraphrases.rewrite: He believed he had asked all the questions he had planned.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 予定していた質問を全部尋ねたと思った。

paraphrases.source: Together, they wrote down his questions and left room for answers.
paraphrases.rewrite: They recorded his questions and kept space for the replies.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 質問を書き、回答欄を確保した。

paraphrases.source: When an explanation was unclear, he asked the doctor to explain again.
paraphrases.rewrite: If he did not understand an explanation, he requested another one.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 理解できない説明は再度求めた。

paraphrases.source: But it helped him take a more active part in the discussion.
paraphrases.rewrite: However, it allowed him to participate more actively in the conversation.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 会話により積極的に参加する助けになった。

cloze.explanation_ja: 説明が分かりにくかった。
紙自体は医学的助言を与えられない。
